# Festival Insider Platform

Multi-festival companion app engine. Two standalone apps sharing one data source.

## What it is
White-label platform powering 4 festival apps (Sziget 2026, Nova Rock, Frequency, Area 53) from a single codebase. Config-first: all branding, colors, dates, and feature flags live in `festivals/<id>/config.json`.

## Platforms
- **Web**: Next.js 16 / React 19 App Router — repo root
- **Android**: Jetpack Compose / Kotlin 2.0.21 — `android/` directory

## Key constraints
- `startTime` and `endTime` are null for all artists — schedule not yet published. Do not build UI that assumes they exist.
- No camera features (hard mandate)
- Offline-first: every core feature works with no signal
- No hardcoded colors, names, or coordinates in components

## Canonical docs
- `AGENTS.md` — coding rules, architecture patterns, commands
- `CURRENT.md` — full platform state snapshot (routes, integrity checks, open items)
- `docs/GOALS.md` — purpose and goal of every feature and the platform as a whole
- `docs/features/FEATURES.md` — build status per feature per platform
- `docs/guides/MANDATES.md` — hard constraints (privacy, offline, config-first)
- `docs/guides/HANDOFF.md` — agent onboarding guide
- `android/README.md` — Android file tree, Room schema, design system

## Data
Source of truth: `festivals/<id>/data/*.json`. Sync to app: `npm run lineup:sync`. 412 artists across 4 festivals, 100% vibe coverage.

## Verify before committing
```
npm run typecheck   # must return 0 errors
npm test -- --run   # 198/198 must pass
```
